rules.title: Set up both
rules.description: Enter your app's URL, start a Synthetic Monitoring uptime check on it, and get the Frontend Observability snippet for the same origin. Requires Editor access.

rules.title: Synthetic Monitoring
rules.description: Check availability and response time from locations around the world.

rules.title: Frontend Observability
rules.description: Explore real user sessions, performance, and errors with the Faro Web SDK.

blocks.title: Digital Experience Monitoring
blocks.description: Understand your website from the outside in with Synthetic Monitoring and the inside out with Frontend Observability.

blocks.content: Follow the guided setup to create an uptime check and connect your website to Frontend Observability. Requires Editor access.
Start with either product and add the other whenever you are ready.
